classes.name: Code review

classes.name: Game development
classes.description: Drive the Unity, Godot and Unreal editors and generate 3D models a game project can import.

classes.name: Security testing
classes.description: Find and fix vulnerabilities in code and systems you own: security review, scanners for code, dependencies and secrets, threat models and authorized pen tests.

classes.name: QA testing
classes.description: Test the product the way users meet it: end-to-end and cross-browser suites, real devices, accessibility, visual regressions, APIs and load.

classes.name: Image generation and editing
classes.description: Generate and edit images with an agent: concept art, product shots, retouching, background removal, upscaling and sizes for every platform.

classes.name: Video generation

classes.name: Audio, voice and music

classes.name: Data analysis
classes.description: Ask questions of your data: SQL against warehouses and spreadsheets, notebooks, product analytics, charts and dashboards.

classes.name: Research and web data
classes.description: Search the web, crawl and scrape pages, read papers and docs, and come back with answers that cite their sources.

classes.name: Cloud and DevOps
classes.description: Run infrastructure with an agent: cloud resources, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI pipelines, logs, metrics and incidents.

classes.name: AI and agent engineering
classes.description: Build and test AI features: agents, MCP servers, retrieval, fine-tuning, evals and tracing.

classes.name: Marketing and sales
classes.description: Plan campaigns, write copy, audit SEO, read analytics and work the CRM pipeline with an agent.

classes.name: Business operations
classes.description: Handle the work around the product: support tickets, invoices and the books, contracts and hiring.
